title: Read a functional requirements document — read_frd
code: path <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt") writeLines("FRD-001: Set BASEFL to Y for BASELINE visits.", path) frd <- read_frd(path) frd$text #> [1] "FRD-001: Set BASEFL to Y for BASELINE visits." unlink(path)

title: sastestgenerator 0.0.1
text: app.R now provides bslib-based Shiny workflow generating downloading FRD-driven SAS validation matrices. generate_sas_tests_openrouter() calls OpenRouter ellmer using literal model identifier gpt-4o-mini default. generate_sas_tests() creates LLM-ready prompt structured result. import_sas_macro() reads SAS source extracts macro metadata. read_frd() reads text-based functional requirements documents.
